# Takumi Docs

## helpers

- [Helpers](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/helpers): Build inputs and load images without the renderer.

## image-response

- [ImageResponse](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/image-response): Serve rendered images over HTTP with a next/og-compatible Response.

## docs

- [Introduction](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs): A Rust engine that renders JSX, HTML, and node trees into images. No headless browser.

## integration

- [Astro](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/integration/astro): Generate Open Graph images for every page at build time.
- [Integration](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/integration): Use Takumi in your framework.
- [Next.js](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/integration/nextjs): Use Takumi to render your React components on the server.
- [Nuxt](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/integration/nuxt): Use Takumi through Nuxt OG Image in Nuxt apps.
- [SvelteKit](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/integration/sveltekit): Use Takumi to render your Svelte components on the server.
- [TanStack Start](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/integration/tanstack-start): Use Takumi to render your React components on the server.

## keyframe-animation

- [Keyframe Animation](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/keyframe-animation): Animate scenes with CSS keyframes and render them as GIFs, WebP, APNG, or video frames.

## load-images

- [Images & emoji](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/load-images): Load and cache images, and render emoji.

## measure-api

- [The measure() API](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/measure-api): Measure the node layout without rendering it.

## output-formats

- [Output Formats](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/output-formats): Choose a raster format, set the pixel density, or emit vector SVG.

## performance-and-optimization

- [Performance & Optimization](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/performance-and-optimization): Best practices for building high-performance rendering pipelines with Takumi.

## reference

- [Reference](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/reference): List of everything in Takumi.

## styling

- [Styling](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/styling): How CSS reaches a node, what the stylesheet engine supports, and the Tailwind paths.

## templates

- [Templates](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/templates): A collection of ready-to-use templates for Takumi.

## troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues and solutions when using Takumi.

## typography-and-fonts

- [Typography & Fonts](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/typography-and-fonts): Load fonts, route scripts across them, and style text.

## upgrade

- [Upgrade to v1](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/upgrade/v1): Walks through what's new in v1 and how to upgrade from v0.
- [Upgrade to v2](https://takumi.kane.tw/docs/upgrade/v2): Walks through the breaking changes in v2 and how to upgrade from v1.
